rows.note: Samtec print HSEC6-XXX-XX-X-RA-X-WT-XR rev A, hsec6-xxx-xx-x-ra-x-wt-xr-mkt.pdf sheets 1-4 (Fig 1 -028, Fig 2 -042, Fig 3 -070, Table 1). rows.description: Samtec HSEC6 vertical 0.6 mm edge card socket, {N} positions
rows.note: Samtec flyer F-226 'HSEC6 vertical edge card socket', hsec6-dv.pdf page 2 (the -070 outline drawing and its table). The flyer has no land pattern: pads are the solder tails of the top-view outline, read from the PDF's vector drawing (scale from the printed tail-span dimensions 16.20 / 28.01 / 49.12, C column): tail 0.20 wide (0.9 pt at 4.538 pt/mm), pitch 0.60, in two rows 5.12 apart (measured: 23.23 pt / 4.538; not printed), the two rows in the same columns. The tail length is NOT printed: the drawing shows only the 0.24 mm the tail projects beyond the housing (1.08 pt), used here as the pad length - the real solder pad is longer, so treat the pad length as unknown. Tail groups read from the vector drawing for -070: 28 | 4.01 | 14 | 4.91 | 28 pads (centre to centre), -042: 28 | 4.01 | 14 (C = 28.01 = 16.20 + 7.80 + 4.01), -028: 28 (C = 16.20). Pin 1 (the triangle on the front view, which shares x with the top view) at the right; origin x = centre of the tail span (assumption: the print gives no tail-to-housing offset), y = centre of the two rows; the housing is 6.00 deep (printed) and A wide (A column: 23.88 / 35.60 / 57.02). Assumptions: pins 1..28 are the top row (-y); the print shows no peg, hole or weld-tab positions (the weld tabs and pegs are only in the front view), so none are drawn.

rows.description: Samtec HSEC8 right angle 0.8 mm edge card socket, {N} positions
rows.note: Samtec print HSEC8-1XX-XX-X-RA-XX-XX rev AQ, hsec8-1xx-xx-x-ra-xx-xx-mkt.pdf sheet 1 (Fig 1 bottom view, Table 2). The print has no recommended PCB layout; the pads are the solder tails of its bottom view, read from the PDF's vector drawing (scale 2.5:1 = 7.087 pt/mm, checked against E = 22.40 for -25): two tail rows, feet 0.23 wide x 0.90 long (1.63 pt x 6.37 pt), pitch 0.80 (printed), both rows in the same columns, odd pins in the row nearer the front face (centre 8.25 from it) and even pins in the row 1.85 behind (10.10; both measured, not printed; the odd = nearer-the-front row is an assumption from the front view where pin 01 is the lower contact row). Origin x = centre of the tail span (E = A column of Table 2: 7.20, 15.20, 23.20 one bank; 9.60, 12.80, 22.40, 34.40, 41.60, 42.40, 50.40 two banks), y = centre of the 12.05 housing depth (printed REF; front face at -6.025). Two-bank parts have a key gap of 4.00 centre to centre (A = (m-1)*0.8 + 3.2) after the first H+1 pads from pin 1 (H and J in Table 2: J = H*0.8 is the first bank's span: H = 3 / 5 / 5 / 21 / 26 / 26 / 31 for -09 / -13 / -25 / -40 / -49 / -50 / -60). The bottom view shares x with the front view (pin 01 at the left), so this top-view footprint is mirrored: pin 1 at the right. Pegs: round 1.32 (printed) and an oblong 1.10 x 1.32 (1.10 and 1.32 printed, the oblong is long in y), both 9.30 from the front face (printed) and 3.10 beyond the end tails (3.100 printed; F = E + 6.20 in Table 2), the round one at the pin-1-end side (print left, here right). Housing width K from Table 2 (11.50 .. 54.70), centred on the tails (assumption). The four 1.00 x 1.00 squares at the housing corners are not drawn (not named as pads).

Odd pins (row 01, the lower contact row in the front view) are the row nearer the front: assumption. Origin: x = centre of the tail span (the pegs are symmetric about it), y = centre of the 11.68 housing depth (.460 [11.68] REF; front face at -5.84), so rows at y = 9.605 - 5.84 = 3.765 and 11.505 - 5.84 = 5.665. The bottom view shares x with the front view, where pin 01 is at the left, so this top-view footprint is mirrored: pin 1 at the right. rows.note: Samtec print MEC5-XXX-XX-X-RA-XX-XR rev E, mec5-xxx-xx-x-ra-xx-xr-mkt.pdf sheet 1 (Fig 1 bottom view, Table 1). The print has no recommended PCB layout; the pads are the solder feet of its bottom view, read from the PDF's vector drawing (scale 3:1 = 8.504 pt/mm, checked against E = 27.00 for the -050 shown): feet 0.23 wide (1.96 pt) x 0.90 long (7.6 / 7.7 pt), pitch 0.50 (printed: 0.500+-0.070), the two rows in the same columns and 3.10 apart centre to centre (26.35 pt, measured, not printed). Tail span E = (No OF POS - 1) x 0.5 (-030: 14.50, -040: 19.50) or, with the key gap, (No OF POS + 4) x 0.5 (-070: 37.00, -080: 42.00; Table 1). The key gap is 3.00 centre to centre (3.00+-0.10 printed) after the first D/0.5 + 1 tails from pin 01 (D = 18.50 for -070, 21.00 for -080; no gap for -030 / -040: 'polarization rib is not present on -030 & -040'). The bottom view shares x with the front view (pin 01 at the left), so this top-view footprint is mirrored: pin 1 at the right. Odd pins (row 01) are the row nearer the front (assumption), i.e. y = -1.55; even pins +1.55. The print does not locate the housing relative to the feet: the origin is the middle of the two foot rows (x centred on the tails), the housing is drawn A wide (Table 1: 23.38 / 28.38 / 45.88 / 50.88 = No OF POS x 0.5 + 8.38, +2.50 with the key gap) and 5.45 deep (5.45 REF), centred on that origin - an approximation. Weld tabs (W2) and pegs are not drawn.
